'''Chris Schwartz''' was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 61) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at Moscow, ID on the 3 December 2005 roster.<ref name="vol20051203">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051203064943/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 December 2005)</ref> In January 2004, posting as WyldFya on the Players Committee forum, he wrote that he had recently moved to Moscow, Idaho and was looking to start a tournament ring for the Moscow, Pullman, Spokane, Lewiston and Clarkston area with [[Karl Walker]].<ref name="pcf-2658-39554">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39554#39554 Moscow Pullman Spokane Lewiston Clarkston tourney's], WyldFya, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040306021952/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39554%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
